TABLE.label: Table
TABLE.description: A sortable, searchable grid over the rows.

FORM.label: Form
FORM.description: One record at a time, laid out as a form.

CARDS.label: Cards
CARDS.description: Rows as a grid of cards - good for images or summaries.

MAP.label: Map
MAP.description: Rows plotted on a map, from a location column.

KANBAN.label: Kanban
KANBAN.description: Rows grouped into columns by a status field.

CALENDAR.label: Calendar
CALENDAR.description: Rows placed on a calendar by a date column.

GANTT.label: Gantt
GANTT.description: Rows as timeline bars, from start/end date columns.

TREE.label: Tree
TREE.description: A hierarchy - rows under their parent row, as a tree or an org chart.

EXTERNALFRAME.label: External frame
EXTERNALFRAME.description: Embed an external page or app - no data source.

MASTER_DETAIL.label: Master-detail
MASTER_DETAIL.description: A new record with its detail rows - an order and its items.

CUSTOM.label: Custom
CUSTOM.description: A blank page: place any widget, bind it to variables, wire it with code.

SETTINGS.label: Settings
SETTINGS.description: A parameter table - one row per setting (key, value, title, description), edited in place like TotalBase's own Settings.

READ.label: Read
READ.description: Opens read-only. Edit/New available per permissions (default).

UPDATE.label: Update
UPDATE.description: Opens the loaded record already in edit mode - no read-only step.

CREATE.label: Create
CREATE.description: Always a blank form for new records - no browsing or editing existing ones.

SINGLE.label: Single record
SINGLE.description: The table's one row, opened to edit - created on the first save when there is none. No New, search, browsing, copy or delete.

NEW_RECORD.label: New record
NEW_RECORD.description: Opens a new record right away, from the table's defaults (default).

WAIT.label: Wait for New
WAIT.description: Opens on a New button - each click starts a record.

DRAWER.label: Drawer
DRAWER.description: Slides up from the bottom, covering most of the screen - for a heavy form: a rich text editor, tabs, a detail.

MODAL.label: Modal
MODAL.description: Centered dialog - best for short forms with few fields.

SIDEBAR.label: Sidebar
SIDEBAR.description: Slides in from the side, beside the list - the fields in one column; best for most forms (default).

PAGE.label: Page
PAGE.description: Its own dedicated URL - best for long forms with many fields, like the Settings pages.

auto_show.label: Add them shown
auto_show.description: In the list and at the end of the record form (default).

auto_hide.label: Add them hidden
auto_hide.description: In the list, hidden - read, not shown, until someone shows it; not in the form.

locked.label: Don't add them
locked.description: The DataView keeps the columns it has - Add columns… can still bring one in.
